servinfo.title: Coolant Level Check
servinfo.ptxt: Before performing the following procedure, observe Precautions for Cooling System:K14D .
It is not necessary to remove degassing tank cap to check coolant level.
When engine is cool, check coolant level in degassing tank (1).
Normal coolant level should be between “FULL” mark (2) and “LOW” mark (3) on degassing tank.
If coolant level is below “LOW” mark, remove degassing tank cap (4) and add proper coolant to degassing tank to bring coolant level up to “FULL” mark.

attention3.ptxt: If proper quality antifreeze is used, there is no need to add extra rust inhibitors or other additives that claim to improve system. They may be harmful to proper operation of system, and are unnecessary expense.
